name: Tubridgi / Wheatstone
description: Chevron-operated Wheatstone LNG and domestic gas plant near Onslow, WA — a supply point into the Dampier to Bunbury (DBP) and Pilbara pipeline network.

name: Gorgon (Barrow Island)
description: Chevron-operated Gorgon LNG and domestic gas plant on Barrow Island, connected into the Dampier hub area.

name: Dampier Hub
description: Pilbara coastal hub where Woodside's North West Shelf gas processing connects into the Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline (DBP) and the Goldfields Gas Pipeline (GGP).

name: Port Hedland
description: Pilbara port town served by the regional Pilbara Pipeline System, and the start of the Telfer Gas Pipeline.

name: Telfer
description: Remote Pilbara gold/copper mine supplied by the Telfer Gas Pipeline from Port Hedland.

name: Newman
description: Pilbara mining town and junction point on the Goldfields Gas Pipeline (GGP), also linked toward Kalgoorlie via the Northern Goldfields Interconnect.

name: Kalgoorlie
description: Goldfields mining hub, the southern terminus of the Goldfields Gas Pipeline (GGP) and origin of the Eastern Goldfields Pipeline System.

name: Kambalda
description: Goldfields mining town south of Kalgoorlie, connected via the Kalgoorlie-Kambalda Pipeline and onward to Esperance.

name: Esperance
description: South coast WA port town, the terminus of the Eastern Goldfields Pipeline System and the Kambalda Esperance Gas Pipeline.

name: Windimurra
description: Mid West WA vanadium mine served by the Mid West Pipeline.

name: Geraldton
description: Mid West WA coastal city, the western end of the Mid West Pipeline.

name: MSF
description: Metering/supply facility on the Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline (DBP) where the Mid West Pipeline and Parmelia Gas Pipeline (PGP) connect into the main trunk line.

name: Perth Hub
description: Perth metropolitan gas distribution hub (Metro North and Metro South zones), the largest demand centre on the WA gas network.

name: Waggerup & Pinjarra (DBP Connect)
description: Alcoa alumina refineries south of Perth connected directly into the Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline (DBP).

name: Bunbury
description: South-west WA port city, the southern terminus of the Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline (DBP).
